author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Robles leaves game early Thursday
desc: Victor Robles left Thursday's game early against the Angels.
impact: Robles entered the game for Julio Rodriguez (who also left with an injury) and was hit on the forearm in his first plate appearance. He'll head to be further evaluated.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: James McCann (quad) begins rehab assignment Thursday
desc: James McCann is starting behind the plate and hitting fourth in his first rehab game with Triple-A Reno on Thursday.
impact: McCann has been sidelined since May 19 due to a strained right quad. He's expected to play in multiple rehab games before being activated from the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ian Seymour fans eight batters in win Thursay
desc: Ian Seymour allowed one run on three hits and one walk while striking out eight across six innings in Thursday's 5-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Seymour surrendered a leadoff home run to Carter Jensen but settled in quickly, allowing just two more hits the rest of the way: a first-inning double to Lane Thomas and a sixth-inning single to Jac Caglianone. He struck out a season-high eight batters and has been dominant over his last two starts, allowing just one run while fanning 15 across 12.2 innings. Through four starts this season, he owns a 3.18 ERA and 0.88 WHIP. Seymour is lined up to make his next start on Tuesday against the New York Yankees.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julio Rodriguez leaves game early Thursday
desc: Julio Rodriguez was removed from Thursday's game early against the Angels.
impact: Rodriguez was hit on the back of his helmet running from first base to second base. He originally stayed in the game before he was later taken out. He'll be further evaluated in the clubhouse.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Baker records save Thursday
desc: Bryan Baker tossed a perfect ninth inning on Thursday to earn the save in a 5-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Baker hadn't pitched since June 27 but showed no signs of rust, retiring the side in order while striking out one on just eight pitches. He's been dominant this season, posting a 1.89 ERA and 0.84 WHIP while ranking second in the majors with 22 saves.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson records three hits Thursday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 3-for-4 with two runs scored and a stolen base in Thursday's 5-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Simpson recorded his second straight multi-hit game on Thursday and extended his hitting streak to seven games. During that stretch, he's slashing .385/.429/.500 with three extra-base hits and three stolen bases.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cedric Mullins II goes deep Thursday
desc: Cedric Mullins II went 2-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and two RBI in Thursday's 5-2 victory over the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Mullins singled in the third inning before belting a 385-foot home run in the fifth to extend the Tampa Bay Rays' lead to 5-1. He's been on a tear lately, riding a seven-game hitting streak while slashing .370/.379/.815 with four home runs and eight RBI during that span.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Otto Lopez finishes home run shy of cycle Thursday
desc: Otto Lopez went 3-for-5 with a triple, a double, a single and two runs scored in Thursday's 14-4 loss to the Colorado Rockies.
impact: Lopez fell a home run shy of the cycle Thursday, but still turned in another productive performance. He finished the series against the Rockies 6-for-14 with four extra-base hits, three runs scored and one RBI. Lopez has also reclaimed the major-league lead in batting average, hitting .336 on the season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Dustin May exits early Thursday
desc: Dustin May exited Thursday night's contest between the St. Louis Cardinals and Atlanta Braves after being struck by a line drive according to Derrick Goold.
impact: May suffered a right leg contusion and will be re-evaluated after allowing five earned runs on five hits and two walks while striking out one over 2/3 of an inning for manager Oliver Marmol, with lefty Justin Bruihl being summoned from the St. Louis bullpen.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Andrew Abbott battles control in no-decision
desc: Andrew Abbott allowed two earned runs on five hits and five walks while striking out three over five innings in Wednesday's loss to the Brewers.
impact: Abbott has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing more than two earned runs in three of his last six contests. The left-hander remains one of the more stable starting options as part of an inconsistent Reds starting staff for manager Terry Francona, carrying a 3.88 ERA and 1.44 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 1.6 K/BB ratio through 18 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Troy Melton turns in another strong outing in win over Yankees
desc: Troy Melton allowed two hits and one walk while striking out seven over 6 1/3 scoreless innings in Wednesday's win over the Yankees.
impact: Melton continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in six of seven trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager AJ Hinch another dynamic starting option in the Tigers rotation since returning, carrying a 2.05 ERA and 0.80 WHIP to go with a 4-1 record and .553 OPS allowed across seven starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Riley Greene swipes base in win over Yankees
desc: Riley Greene went 0-for-3 in Wednesday's 6-2 win over the Yankees with one RBI, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Greene continues a steady stretch of late, reaching base in eight of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more impactful options as part of a streaky Tigers lineup for manager AJ Hinch, posting an .822 OPS with 11 home runs, 38 RBI, 44 runs scored, and two stolen bases over 86 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin McGonigle goes deep in win over Yankees
desc: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-5 in a win over the Yankees with a solo home run and two runs scored.
impact: McGonigle continues an impactful stretch of late, getting on base in 17 of his last 18 contests. The rookie continues to reward manager AJ Hinch as one of the few dynamic options in an inconsistent Tigers lineup, carrying an .815 OPS with seven home runs, 31 RBI, 54 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 84 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dustin Harris opts out of minor league deal with White Sox
desc: Dustin Harris opted out of his minor-league contract with the Chicago White Sox.
impact: Harris was hitting .312 with an .886 OPS with Triple-A Charlotte. He is now a free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hurston Waldrep to throw 75-80 pitches Thursday
desc: Braves manager Walt Weiss said they're hoping to get 75-80 pitches out of Hurston Waldrep on Thursday.
impact: Waldrep is taking the mound against the Cardinals. He'll likely look to at least go five frames for Atlanta.
